scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why code signing fails with access denied

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy configurations

scenarios.reasoning: The agent produced a well-evidenced, specific root-cause analysis grounded in actual binlog data: identified the exact failing file, contrasted the succeeding obj-dir signing pass, spotted MSB4120 self-referencing metadata warnings as the mechanism pulling a foreign binary into the sign list, explained the race under parallel builds, ruled out alternatives, and gave prioritized fixes. Minor deductions for not considering read-only/hard-link ACL mechanisms and a few wasted tool calls on temp-file retrieval, but the analysis is strong and actionable.
